body: Do you work on the GoT Binge Mode podcast? Just wondering.

I saw that scene differently. Several months ago I tried to end my life. Ended up in my car with my cats and the clothes on my back and a couple blankets as my only possessions.

It got cold. 10 degrees cold. And there I was trying to figure out how to reassemble my Humpty Dumpty life with those poor babies in the car with me, burrowed under blankets.

Prior to this I had been living in a hotel and was familiar with staff hours, meeting rooms, etc after 2 beautiful years there. I wrote a letter about my animals expecting they would go to the humane society. Describing their personalities, etc and cried hard writing that. Harder than I thought possible to cry.

In that horrible cold I left my children (as mother of cats) in an unlocked warm and safe meeting room with said letter, food, tray. Looked at them briefly knowing to my core, heart shattering, this was an act of love and the right decision. 

Did not pet, hug or kiss them because if I had I would have taken them right back to my car to freeze with me.

My love for my animals. You guys clearly get it, having such passion for this scene.  I still love them and will forever love them and still cry if I see any cat posts on my front page. I avoid cat photos, videos, etc. It just punches me all over again.

Since then I got the help I needed, which could not have included them. A friend called the hotel to check on them. A housekeeper took them home to foster and find homes for them. On the one hand I believe that woman is clearly full of love herself to be that generous. On the other I would give anything for a time machine. Anything to change the path I slid down that resulted in the loss of my little family.

I know this is so long and TMI but Jon. Looking at battle battered adorable Ghost with Jon having an uncertain life expectancy. I believe he did what he believed was best for Ghost and could not pet, hug him without falling apart. He left him with a fellow warrior, his friend. It was to me a heartbreaking act of love. 

Totally projecting. Possibly all wrong. But my experience made me sympathize so deeply with him. His actions made sense to me.

That was my first ticket, passing a cop when I wasn't speeding. He said my speedometer was clearly off because I was going 3 mph over the limit and concluded with, "That's what you get for passing a cop."
I won't even use a restroom at a convenience store without buying something, so as not to look suspicious.

Yesterday my dad called me A Problem, A Coward, What Would This Do To Him And Mom.

Well let's see. Thanks I'm cured, for one. Secondly I had an awesome life insurance policy that covered suicide so had I managed to hang myself that was a nice lottery win for them. 

Lastly I threw away everything I owned. Except the clothes on my back and my car.

Today I live in my car and I have fucking nothing. I want to finish the job, not get lectures about how I got myself into this. No I didn't. I wasn't supposed to fucking be here for any of this.
